thread.title: Amazon on track to cross $900 billion market-cap threshold

author: morningstar.com
title: Amazon on track to cross $900 billion market-cap threshold
text:
Shares of Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) shot up 4.3% toward a record high in premarket trade Friday, after blowout second-quarter results (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/amazon-earnings-explode-to-record-thanks-to-surprising-e-commerce-profit-stock-gains-2018-07-26), to put the e-commerce giant on track to cross above the $900 billion market-capitalization threshold for first time. At current stock price levels, Amazon would be valued at about $919.4 billion. That would still make it the second-biggest U.S. company, as Apple Inc. shares' (AAPL) premarket gain of 0.3% would put the technology giant at about $957.9 billion.
-Tomi Kilgore; 0726ET
